title.narrative: Bolon Sammonito Krishi Farm O Duckling Hatchery

description.narrative: Bolon Sammonito Krishi Farm O Duckling Hatchery is a small rural enterprise based in Gaibandha district in Northern Bangladesh. The enterprise was established in 2007 with an initial investment of GBP5,000 only. The enterprise uses fertilized eggs to produce day old duckling (DOD) which it markets directly to local duck farmers (75% women), adjacent district's duckling buyers & farmers. Ducklings are produced via two incubator units: a rice -husk incubator (low cost traditional hatching method) and a local made semi -automated electric incubator. The hatching season is limited by climate conditions and the availability of fertilized eggs is typically from January to August. The average duckling production rate from fertilized eggs is 75%. Currently the hatchery produces and markets 180,000 pieces of DOD per year, which represents a 40% of total sales in the Gaibandha district. The objectives of the hatchery are as follows. - Consolidating the existing expertise, leadership and reputation in the local market he (entrepreneur) is intended to enhance his production and selling capacity by twice to catch up the unfulfilled current market demand. - Expanding operations into 10 to 15 districts, becoming a leader through producing & supplying good variety duckling among privately owned duck hatcheries - Developing the capacity of backyard duck farmers to grow into commercial farming and increase their income. To achieve these goals by 2020, the enterprise will: - Produce up to 372,000 duckling per year: 57% through an automated incubator, 43% with the traditional rice husking method - Provide extension services and training, supporting 100 women entrepreneurs (Current 50 + new 50) to become commercial duck farmers from backyard farmers; The enterprise is requesting Enterprise Development Programme (EDP) support to invest in the following areas: - Working capital for the enterprise - an automated incubator machine with capacity of about 20,000 eggs in each production cy
